cards.title: [TECH-01] Vue 3, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and Vite
cards.description: Vue Composition API drives UI; TypeScript models cities/hours/preferences; HTML labels and CSS implement wireframes; Vite builds independent index.html and demo.html entries. Tooling: Node.js 24, npm, VS Code, Git, GitHub.
checklist: Run npm ci and npm run build
cards.status: Implemented in supplied code; verify on your Mac

cards.title: [TECH-02] Open-Meteo APIs, Fetch, and AbortController
cards.description: Geocoding maps queries to cities. Forecast API retrieves core and supporting measurements. Fetch checks HTTP status. AbortController cancels obsolete work; sequence guards ignore stale responses. No private weather API key or backend is required.
cards.status: Implemented in supplied code; verify live

cards.title: [TECH-03] localStorage and versioned persistence
cards.description: Product key weatherwindow-preferences-v1 stores city, five recent choices, canonical Fahrenheit thresholds, and display unit. Lab uses a separate key. No server database or cross-device sync.
checklist: Reload and restore last city and limits
cards.status: Implemented in supplied code; verify locally

cards.title: [TECH-04] Vitest, Playwright, GitHub Actions, and Pages
cards.description: Vitest checks deterministic rules. Playwright tests actual UI with explicit fixtures. GitHub Actions runs unit checks and builds both pages. Pages hosting is optional until the user publishes it.
checklist: Install Chromium and run npm run test:e2e
cards.status: Tests and workflow supplied; hosting not performed

cards.description: Request 48 hourly slots from the current hour; specify Fahrenheit, mph, inches, Unix timestamps, and auto timezone. Preserve missing data as null.

cards.title: [W2-01] Temperature, wind, and rain controls
cards.description: Use accessible numeric inputs and sliders. Minimum <= maximum; wind >= 0; rain 0–100. Comparisons are inclusive and all three rules must pass. Invalid edits show feedback and do not overwrite saved valid preferences.
checklist: Check invalid inputs preserve saved values
cards.status: Implemented in supplied code; verify locally

cards.title: [W2-02] Fahrenheit and Celsius display conversion
cards.description: Store and compare canonical Fahrenheit values. Convert display and entered temperature values, avoiding repeated conversion drift. Wind remains mph and precipitation remains inches.
checklist: Switch F/C with same match count
cards.status: Implemented in supplied code; verify locally

cards.title: [W2-03] Interactive 48-hour timeline
cards.description: Render one cell per hour with match/outside/unavailable states and accessible measurement labels. A matching cell opens its row; other cells open condition details. Mobile timeline scrolls horizontally.
checklist: Use keyboard to reach each cell
cards.status: Implemented in supplied code; verify locally

cards.title: [W2-04] Matching-hour rows and mobile cards
cards.description: Show local date/time, temperature, wind, rain chance, match count, and why-it-matches chips. Desktop list scrolls vertically; mobile cards swipe horizontally.
cards.status: Implemented in supplied code; verify locally

cards.title: [W2-05] Expanded hour conditions and explanations
cards.description: Expand the selected hour inline. Show feels-like temperature, humidity, WMO condition text, wind direction/gusts, precipitation, and cloud cover where available. Explain core rule comparisons; missing supporting values do not change matches.
cards.status: Implemented in supplied code; verify live
